Container.Name: Nebula-Console
Container.Overview: Nebula Console manages Helios distributions with external MariaDB and RustFS services. Use a custom Docker network shared with MariaDB, RustFS, and the HTTPS reverse proxy whenever possible.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Nebula Console HTTP port. Point your HTTPS reverse proxy at this port.

Config.Name: Forge Cache
Config.Description: Persistent Forge installer cache. Prefer SSD-backed appdata.

Config.Name: Application Base URL
Config.Description: Exact public HTTPS URL used to open Nebula Console, without a trailing slash.

Config.Name: MariaDB Connection URL
Config.Description: mysql://user:URL_ENCODED_PASSWORD@mariadb:3306/nebula. Do not use localhost for another container.

Config.Name: Cookie Secret
Config.Description: At least 32 random characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: RustFS S3 Endpoint
Config.Description: Internal RustFS S3 API URL. This is not the RustFS console port.

Config.Name: RustFS Bucket
Config.Description: Existing bucket that grants the App read/write access to private/* and public/*.

Config.Name: RustFS Access Key ID
Config.Description: S3 access key used by Nebula Console.

Config.Name: RustFS Secret Access Key
Config.Description: S3 secret key used by Nebula Console.

Config.Name: RustFS Public Base URL
Config.Description: Public or CDN base URL for the bucket. Helios downloads public/* objects from this URL.

Config.Name: Trust Reverse Proxy
Config.Description: Keep true when Nginx, SWAG, or Traefik terminates HTTPS.

Config.Name: Secure Cookies
Config.Description: Keep true for HTTPS. Use false only for an HTTP-only LAN test.

Config.Name: RustFS Region
Config.Description: S3 signing region configured for RustFS.

Config.Name: CurseForge API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Required only for CurseForge ZIP imports.

Config.Name: Maximum Upload Bytes
Config.Description: Maximum upload size in bytes. The reverse proxy limit must be at least this large.

Config.Name: Enable Background Worker
Config.Description: Runs publish and CurseForge import jobs in this container.

Config.Name: Worker Poll Milliseconds
Config.Description: Database queue polling interval. Minimum 250 ms.

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Fixed production runtime mode.

Config.Name: Listen Host
Config.Description: Fixed container listen address.

Config.Name: Listen Port
Config.Description: Fixed internal HTTP port.

Config.Name: Java Executable
Config.Description: Java 17 executable included in the image.
